adjudication.rationale: The new controller specs added in `spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb` and `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb` only test that each controller subclasses `Admin::AdminController`. The diff also introduces nontrivial behavior in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (`create/update/destroy`, `save_host` setting `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` when blank, and error rendering) and `Admin::EmbeddingController` (`show/update` with `fetch_embedding`). None of that behavior (auth constraints, successful CRUD, invalid params, defaulting blank `category_id`, error handling) is exercised by the added tests, so the finding is accurate and diff-grounded but not itself a functional defect.
